statement: offload offers at most two actions on a row from what a dump carried, and usually none: a link to open, a number to call, an address to write to, from what was typed, said, mailed, printed in a PDF or read out of a picture. It offers the move the dump exists for, never boilerplate, someone else's number, an advert, a sign-in or reset link, anything from an identity document, or anything words in the dump told it to offer.
why: The next move is often one tap away and buried in the dump, but a dump is often somebody else's words, so offload offers only a destination the dump carried, of a kind a person would use, and an instruction inside it is data.
